import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    T = int(next(it))
    a.sort()
    ans = 1
    l = 0
    for r in range(n):
        while l < r and a[r] - a[l] > T:
            l += 1
        if a[r] - a[l] <= T:
            ans = max(ans, r - l + 1)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
